2. DPS Admission System Update

This document outlines the key functional upgrades recently implemented in the DPS Admission System. These enhancements streamline data management, integrate website enquiries seamlessly, secure administrative access, and provide comprehensive tracking for student applications.

A. Extended Application Fields

The application system has been upgraded to support a comprehensive set of enquiry fields. Beyond the original core information, the database and forms now capture detailed student backgrounds, parent/guardian information, residential addresses, sibling details, and professional profiles. Shared validation rules ensure complete consistency across both administrative edits and bulk CSV/Excel data imports.

B. One-Click DPS Website Admission-Query Sync

A streamlined integration service has been introduced to connect the public-facing WordPress website (https://dpsmegacity.in/admission-enquiry) directly with the administrative portal (https://admission.dpsmegacity.in). Staff can now import website admission enquiries into the main database with a single click. The system automatically handles duplicate detection based on unique form identifiers to prevent redundant records.

C. Software Features Incorporation (https://admission.dpsmegacity.in/)

a)     Google Form update

b)     Auto Sync DPS website enquiry

c)     Import Facebook leads with duplicate check

d)     Edit student admission details

e)     Role basis user access for student records (Like: Permission for Edit, View, Delete)

f)      Dashboard easy count show for lead source basis.

g)     Email Integration

h)     Lead categorization (Google Ad, Meta Ad, others)

Performance Observation:

       I.          Lead Generation: Meta generated 183 leads, while Google generated 16 leads, resulting in 199 total leads during the reporting period.

 

     II.          Meta Ad Performance: The Meta Lead Ad Campaign achieved a CPL of ₹112.68, making Meta the primary lead-generation channel.

 

   III.          Organic Search Visibility: Google Search Console recorded 108K impressions and 7.55K clicks, with an average CTR of 7% and average position of 6.5.

 

 

    IV.          SEO Keyword Performance: Several targeted keywords are ranking within the top 10, including Best ICSE School in Kolkata (#3) and Best ISC School in Kolkata (#5).

 

      V.          Facebook Growth: Facebook generated 429.1K content views, 10.5K page visits, and 262 new followers during the period.

 

    VI.          Instagram Growth: Instagram achieved 350.7K content views, 87K reach, and 354 new followers, indicating good audience expansion.

 

  VII.          Non-Follower Reach: A significant share of social media visibility came from non-followers, indicating that the content is reaching audiences beyond the existing follower base.

 

VIII.          Content Performance: Event-focused Reels, particularly around the Junior and Senior Investiture Ceremony, contributed to the month's content activity and audience engagement.

 

    IX.          Overall Observation: Overall digital performance shows positive movement in lead generation, SEO visibility, social media reach, and audience growth. The next focus should be on improving lead quality and conversion, expanding non-branded SEO keywords, and maintaining consistent student- and event-focused content.
